seeds.name: Sequence Desk
seeds.lesson: A convincing SaaS interface must prove loading, empty, error, selection, and completion states instead of presenting a polished static dashboard.
seeds.visual_hook: the same component changing state before the full page appears.
seeds.limitations: Internal QA evidence only; no field conversion or user-research claim.

seeds.name: Orbital Commons
seeds.lesson: Spatial effects earn their cost only when they clarify hierarchy, comparison, or story and preserve an accessible semantic fallback.
seeds.visual_hook: the spatial data scene switching to its reduced-motion and semantic fallback.
seeds.limitations: Pseudo-3D demonstration, not proof that 3D improves every interface.

seeds.name: Afterimage Atlas
seeds.lesson: Distinctive editorial interfaces come from hierarchy, cropping, rhythm, and an inspection verb—not from applying a fashionable palette to a card grid.
seeds.visual_hook: the archive overview contrasted with the object-inspection interaction.
seeds.limitations: Fictional concept content with internal artifact scoring.

seeds.name: Linehold Forge
seeds.lesson: A dense B2B interface should help a buyer compare risk and evidence rather than imitate consumer SaaS minimalism.
seeds.visual_hook: the supplier-evaluation decision surface revealing its evidence hierarchy.
seeds.limitations: Internal score remains below the project's target and buyer validation is pending.

seeds.name: Nocturne Concierge
seeds.lesson: Atmosphere should support booking confidence and orientation; decorative motion cannot replace a clear service and navigation model.
seeds.visual_hook: the atmospheric first impression followed by keyboard navigation and the reduced-motion state.
seeds.limitations: Fictional hospitality concept; field Core Web Vitals and booking conversion are unverified.
